test_bbox_overlaps_2d: test the BboxOverlaps2D class and bbox_overlaps function with GIoU and IoF modes
run_BboxOverlaps2D_giou: run BboxOverlaps2D to compute generalized IoU between two aligned bounding box tensors
run_bbox_overlaps_iof: run bbox_overlaps with mode iof to compute intersection over foreground ratios
test_bbox_overlaps_aligned: test bbox_overlaps with is_aligned True to compute per-pair GIoU scores
test_bbox_overlaps_batched: test BboxOverlaps2D with batched multi-dimensional bounding box tensors for GIoU
